summary: Reproduced the paged-prefill dispatch defect in the prepared source: prefill allocates required raw indices, while the v2 branch required that buffer to be absent, making v1 unavoidable. The candidate routes all enabled sgl-kernel paged top-k calls through v2; when sparse prefill needs raw indices, v2 writes them and a separate page-table transform produces the physical indices. Focused regressions and a 32K numerical check passed on gfx950, but the original four-GB300 DeepSeek-V4-Pro serving crash could not be reproduced in this environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: the required v2 raw-plus-paged dispatch helper was absent; source inspection also showed prefill raw allocation combined with the raw_indices-is-None v2 guard.

Three regression/boundary cases: v2 is used while raw indices are retained, physical page translation preserves invalid -1 entries and crosses page boundaries, page_size=1 works, and the no-raw path retains the fused v2 page transform. The primary case ran tensor operations on the assigned GPU.
Actual repository v2 JIT kernel matched independent references on gfx950 for permuted paged output and raw output modes (2 passed).

tests.command: ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-73e280aba895/venv/bin/python <32K combined-output numerical script recorded in reproduction.txt>
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI355X, batch=2, seq=32768, k=512: v2 raw selected-index multisets matched torch.topk and derived physical-index multisets matched an independent torch.gather page-table reference.
One pre-existing ROCm-specific subtest mismatch: dsa_drop_wide_page_table was false while the test expected true; one subtest passed. This does not exercise the changed helper.
Patch whitespace and Python bytecode compilation. Ruff was unavailable in the prepared interpreter.

gpu_execution.evidence: Single assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015. Actual v2 JIT paged/raw tests passed and the 32K combined-output check matched independent torch references.

remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA GB300/CUDA 13 hardware and no DeepSeek-V4-Pro weights were available; the original four-GPU TP/DP/EP serving crash was not reproduced before or after this candidate.

The assigned gfx950 run validates kernel execution and index transformation only, not DeepSeek-V4-Pro semantics, FP4 model execution, DP attention, hierarchical cache, speculative decoding, or multi-GPU behavior.
The raw-plus-paged v2 path adds a separate PyTorch page-table transform because the v2 kernel exposes one output; end-to-end performance on the reported GB300 workload remains unmeasured.
A pre-existing ROCm failure in test_topk_v2_respects_topk_backend remains recorded in reproduction.txt.
No native library was changed or rebuilt.
